chunks: Each soul will be paid in full for what it had done. He is cognisant of what you do.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about how souls are recompensed for their deeds?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the precision of divine justice, where every deed—no matter how minute—is accounted for without any loss or addition, reflecting God's perfect knowledge. It serves as a foundational reminder for believers that their ultimate recompense is directly tied to their individual actions, reinforcing the concept of personal responsibility in the hereafter.
